claims.quote: The mango pleco, Baryancistrus chrysolomus, traded as L047, is a loricariid endemic to the rio Xingu basin in Pará state, Brazil.
Endemic to the rio Xingu basin in Pará state, Brazil, where it inhabits a section of the river's main channel known as 'Volta Grande do rio Xingu' directly above Belo Monte falls.

regions.quote: It's also been collected in the upper rio Curuá, a tributary of the rio Iriri which is itself an affluent of the Xingu.
